follow_invert_expectation: FOLLOW has higher paired PnL than INVERT
definition: For BUY Stochastic signals with causal ha_direction == 1 at signal time, estimate paired FOLLOW minus INVERT PnL.
missing_handling: Do not impute; condition rows require observed ha_direction and paired complete outcomes.
failure_criterion: Validation cluster-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for mean directional_advantage crosses or falls below zero, or mean FOLLOW PnL is not greater than mean INVERT PnL.
validation_criterion: At least 500 paired BUY observations; positive directional-advantage mean and cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound above zero; report SELL separately as out of scope, not as evidence for this BUY-only hypothesis.
